docmh-nlss-root.description: Workspace-first R statistics suite with subskills and agent-run metaskills (including run-demo for guided onboarding, explain-statistics for concept explanations, explain-results for interpreting outputs, format-document for NLSS format alignment, screen-data for diagnostics, check-assumptions for model-specific checks, and write-full-report for end-to-end reporting) that produce NLSS format tables/narratives and machine-readable run records from CSV/SAV/RDS/RData/Parquet. Covers descriptives, frequencies/crosstabs, correlations, t-tests/ANOVA/nonparametric, regression/mixed models,…
